message.content: Hey, I need you to draft a quick, friendly email to my neighbour Gemma. I feel terrible about forgetting to pass on the info she asked for yesterday.

content.text: No problem at all. What specifically did she need the information about?

message.content: The name of the optician she mentioned last week. I know I saw it somewhere, I just blanked on the spot. It’s Specsavers.

content.text: Got it. Specsavers. When would you like to send this? I can time it so it arrives while she's likely free, or just send it now?

message.content: Just send it now. I’ve got to get ready for choir rehearsal later. Oh, and could you add a line about how I saw the sign on Saturday 7 March when I was out walking the cat? Just so she knows I didn't lose it completely.

content.text:
I'll include that detail. Here is the draft:

Hi Gemma,

So sorry for the delay! I finally remembered the name of the optician you asked about. It’s Specsavers. I actually saw the sign again on Saturday 7 March when I was out walking the cat, but my brain just didn't click into place until now!

Hope you're having a good weekend.

Best,
Aisha
Email sent. Is there anything else you need help with before you head out?

message.content: Yes, actually. I need to plan dinner for tonight. I have some chicken breasts and broccoli in the fridge, but I’m tired from marking Year 4 essays. Can you suggest something quick?

content.text: Since you're tired, how about a one-pan lemon garlic chicken with broccoli? It takes about 20 minutes. You just roast the chicken and broccoli together with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and some spices. Do you have those pantry staples?

message.content: Yes, I do. Add it to my meal plan for tonight. Also, check my calendar for tomorrow morning. I don't want to oversleep.

content.text: I've added the meal to your plan. Looking at your calendar, you have school tomorrow. Your start time is 8:45 AM. I recommend setting an alarm for 7:00 AM to give yourself enough time for breakfast and getting ready without rushing.

message.content: Thanks. 7:00 AM sounds reasonable. That's all for now.
